notes_for_editor: No official annual-report coverage beyond two fog-alarm entries (keeper tables are OCR column blocks and were not used). Keeper dates conflict: Wilbert MacIntyre ends 1957/1960/1963 and Harris starts 1957/1961/1963; Lauchlin MacDonald ends 1908 (PEILS) or 1911 (station site). 1908 tower move is in the PEI heritage file, PEILS and station timeline but not Lighthouse Friends. Crew size of Phoenix differs (about 150 vs 400 on blog/station timeline), omitted. Lighthouse Friends contradicts itself on ownership (Coast Guard in visitor line, Friends of Elmira in text). Record lists a 1867 vs 1876 build; 1876 appears wrong or unexplained. The 1992 federal heritage designation could not be sourced (Parks Canada page returned a header only). Tower climbable: PEILS yes, LF closed. A 1877-78 superintendent visit is summarized from Lighthouse Friends only. Fog-alarm change (source 7) happened in fiscal year ended 30 June 1906, not 1906-07. Lauchlin MacDonald to 1911 per station site (PEILS 1908). Fog building move 2007 (LF) vs 2008 (PEILS). 'Royal Navy sloop' removed (sources say warship).
